body_face_motion.scope: All8x300 coherent body/head/root/translation fit with fixed actual canonical appearance, beta/scale, finger motions and cameras. Body surface COCO12, screened hands and identity-checked actual-LHM face anchors contribute jointly. Face front/hand screening freezes initial set; not true visibility, and fixed detector definitions can retain bias. Input error changes are not accepted image/contact quality; object motion and depth must refresh after changed body motion. Compare same-init face-weight0 control and actual rendered evidence before adoption.

actual_render_remeasurement.scope: Actual neural body-only renders remeasured with same RTMW and same union-of-both-render-alpha-derived full-body bbox for source/baseline/candidate. Only initially front-facing existing RANSAC-inlier nose/eyes with all3 detector scores>2 contribute. Native1008x756 renders and explicit pixel-center camera affine; reported residuals converted back to2048 native pixels. Proxy-vs-render discrepancy is separately measured. Sampled same-input diagnostic, not independent ground truth; no helmet compositing here. Original-source comparison stays private. Motion-update comparison with canonical tensor identity held exact; per-avatar actual shaped rest FK and motion used for each semantic projection.

implementation_checks.scope: Component identity and control-initialization checks only. Nonzero beta is data-estimated but not certified physical body shape; facial residual/selected rendering evidence is separate. Object integration not validated by this check.

derived_metadata_repair.scope: Only inherited poses.projected metadata recalculated from already-saved updated COCO3D joints and calibrated K/W. Actual render/fit inputs, canonical tensors and every other pose tensor unchanged; previous render/depth evidence remains applicable. Original parent result preserved. Fitter source now writes this derived field directly.

nonplanar_rim_family.scope: Shared canonical level/tilt and side/back rim-drop family: fixed source closed hull,30step bounded smoothing and.001world-numerical-unit shell thickness prior; all8x300 native ROI labels plus visible nose/eye non-coverage evidence. Fixed input poses/body-depth for this geometry block. Full-body segmentation, proxy face visibility and source hull remain imperfect. Selected input score is not real cavity/contact/new-view truth. New UV, texture bake, pose/head refit and actual image comparisons required before adoption; baseline reconstruction is asserted exact. Nonplanar signed-field clipping lowers side/back rim relative to the plane without independently generating each frame. This is a low-dimensional opening-shape prior tested against observations, not measured cavity reconstruction. Plane metadata describes the base plane only; chosen side/back drops are explicit in selected. Surface clipping is linear on each source triangle. Face noncoverage uses frozen initial directional visibility from the stated avatar and semantic anchor identity, excluding hand uncertainty and back-camera hallucinations; still model-dependent screening.

geometry_controls.scope: Actual smoothed closed source hull with9 shared side/back drop combinations; open surface connected, positive watertight thin shell, and no reduction of retained outer area. Zero parameters use original plane code. Topology/implementation controls only, not observed helmet geometry or quality acceptance.

zero_parameter_control.scope: Shared opening-family control only. No observation scoring, optimization or quality claim.

nonplanar_rim_family.conclusion: All nonzero side/back extensions reduce overall score at the current fixed poses; zero extension selected. This fixed-pose experiment does not prove that data-driven nonplanar rims cannot help after a pose update.
